description: This is an HTML frontend for a Database Viewer web application, containing the interface layout, styling, and embedded JavaScript functions for fetching and displaying database information and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data with columns and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed view.

search-terms: Embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetch
